text:
Jules (marketing): Draft invite — idea: 'Cut inference cost while maintaining latency: live benchmarks + demo'
Jules (marketing): Short blurb: Join us for a 45-min deep dive into production inference economics — we'll show real benchmarks, an operational demo, and a resilient fallback flow so you can ship reliably. Save your spot: <https://redwood.com/webinar-reg>
Sam G (content): small wording tweak: change 'cut' to 'reduce' in subject line, and use 'maintaining' instead of 'without sacrificing' — feels cleaner. also suggest CTA: 'Register for the live demo' :white_check_mark:
Priya R (PM): Speaker ask: can we include a 5-min customer mini-case (pre-recorded)? @Diego can you cover the throughput/latency demo + fallback?
Diego (eng demos): Yes. Plan: main demo runs against dedicated pool endpoint, fallback uses a quantized model variant. I'll stand up two endpoints: /demo/main and /demo/fallback.
Diego (eng demos): Local test curl (will share sanitized prompt): ```curl -s -N https://demo.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"prompt":"<stable-demo-prompt>", "max_tokens":150}'```
Nora (demos): Rehearsal? Can we do a full run-through Fri 10:00am PT? OpsBot shows a conflict on host calendar, will check availability.
Jules (marketing): Fri 10am PT ok for panelists? @Sam G @Priya R
Sam G (content): Yes for me.
Priya R (PM): Yes.
Diego (eng demos): Yes.
Nora (demos): I'll lock Fri 10am then and send a calendar invite with a rehearsal checklist. Draft run-of-show below.
Nora (demos): Run-of-show (draft): 1) Host intro + goals (3m) 2) Benchmark narrative + takeaways (7m) 3) Live demo: main endpoint (8m) 4) Fallback demo + error handling (4m) 5) Customer mini-case (5m) 6) Q&A + next steps (18m)
Jules (marketing): Perfect. Logistics: need speaker bios + headshots by Wed EOD, final landing page copy by Thu noon. Also confirm recording opt-in language for registrants.
Sam G (content): I'll send a bio template and two CTA variations for A/B testing. Link to mapping doc when ready: https://docs.google.com/drive/fake-link
Diego (eng demos): Notes for infra / cost control: keep demo token limits low and enable per-endpoint rate limits. Example config snippet I will apply: ```ratelimit: 5rps
max_tokens: 256
enable_cache: true```
Priya R (PM): Lead routing: registrants flagged as 'Enterprise' or 'Product-Interested' should be routed to SalesOps via webhook; others to the nurture campaign. Who wires the webhook?
Jules (marketing): @Sam G to own the mapping doc and rules, @Diego to implement the webhook endpoint /hooks/lead-router -> SalesOps.
Sam G (content): I'll produce the mapping doc today and publish to the marketing wiki, will ping here with the link.
Diego (eng demos): I'll add the webhook and test payload schema. Will post example payloads in the rehearsal thread.
Jules (marketing): Final asks before we close: confirm A/V (mics + slide control), create a 2-min recorded demo clip as a hot fallback, and finalize the session description for the landing page.
Nora (demos): I'll confirm AV with events ops and produce the 2-min clip. Also drafting a one-slide visual that shows the fallback switch sequence.
Jules (marketing): Excellent. :thumbsup: I'll update the invite copy with Sam's wording and share the landing page draft by tomorrow morning. Ping me if anything blocks.
